claims.explanation: Torin-2 is a potent ATP-competitive mTOR inhibitor that blocks both mTORC1 and mTORC2, and its selectivity likely reflects dependence on mTOR-driven survival signaling, particularly when upstream PI3K/AKT pathway mutations or receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) activation create oncogenic addiction. Sensitive lines are enriched for PIK3CA mutations, PTEN loss, EGFR mutations, and BRAF mutations, all of which converge on mTOR activation, whereas resistant lines often have mutations in MTOR itself or in downstream effectors that may bypass mTOR inhibition. The drug also induces autophagy, and autophagy-competent tumors may be more vulnerable to torin-2-induced cell death.

features.basis: Activating PIK3CA mutations drive PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling and are enriched in sensitive lines (HGC27, SNU840, MKN1, KYSE510).
PTEN loss hyperactivates PI3K/AKT/mTOR and is seen in sensitive lines (ZR751, HEC265).
EGFR mutations activate mTOR through PI3K/AKT and are present in sensitive lung lines (NCIH1650, HCC4006, KYSE270).
BRAF V600 mutations activate MAPK and mTOR signaling and are enriched in sensitive melanoma lines (LOXIMVI, IGR37, K029AX, HEC265).
MTOR mutation in resistant SNUC5 may alter drug binding or downstream signaling, reducing torin-2 efficacy.
NF1 loss activates RAS/MAPK and mTOR; seen in sensitive lines (LOXIMVI, BICR6) but also in some resistant lines, so weaker evidence.
KRAS mutations can activate mTOR; present in sensitive lines (GSU, KPNSI9S) but also in resistant lines, suggesting context dependence.
TP53 mutations are common in both sensitive and resistant lines, but some resistant lines have TP53 mutations with intact apoptosis, so not a strong predictor.
ARID1A mutations appear in several sensitive lines (LOXIMVI, HEC265) but also in resistant lines, weak evidence.
KMT2D mutations are frequent in sensitive lines (KYSE270, KE39, HEC265, BICR6) but also in resistant lines, weak evidence.
CDKN2A loss is seen in some resistant lines (MHHES1, SNU1214, IPC298) but also in sensitive K029AX, so not consistent.
ATM mutations appear in resistant lines (SNU685 is sensitive, but 786O and SNUC5 are resistant), weak evidence.
